name: Bird Dog
summary: A floor exercise on all fours that trains trunk stability and coordination, working the back muscles, glutes and abs together.
setup: Start on hands and knees with the wrists under the shoulders and the knees under the hips.
Keep the spine neutral and the neck in line.
execution: Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back at the same time.
Keep the hips and shoulders level and avoid twisting.
Pause for a moment, then return to the start under control.
mistakes: Arching the lower back: lift the limbs only as high as you can keep the spine neutral.
Rotating the hips: keep both hips facing the floor.
Rushing: move slowly and pause at the end.
